title: CrossTxT - Welcome to the Texting Revolution
scope: Homepage, including all five feature/account panels and recoverable referenced images. Linked site pages are not included.
panels: Seamless computer to phone texting for Android devices
Full SMS inbox synchronization from phone to computer
Your messages will never be lost when they are backed up on the cloud!
We don't want our life public, security is key.
Think you're ready? Sign up for your free account now!
changes: Removed original scripts and event handlers.
Replaced the automatic carousel with CSS-only feature tabs; printing includes every panel.
Disabled historical login and signup forms. Removed the hidden loading indicator and favicon.
Saved recoverable homepage images and CSS backgrounds locally. Unavailable backgrounds omitted; missing illustrations use labeled placeholders and missing decorative bullets use text bullets.
Pointed external and uncopied page links at Wayback. Added archive notice, noindex, and content security policy.
